# The remaining conjectures (C1-C7) and exactly what closes each

Everything else in the reduction C(P112) >= 64 (via #2832: K1 two-sided + K2 one-sided) is proved or checked in this package or in the PRs it builds on (dependency map in README.md).
No kappa claim, no window, no supplier word.  Notation is that of the cited cards (copies in `checks/<CARD>/NOTES.md`).

| id | side | statement (what is missing) | closes it | where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | K1 two-sided | Conjecture G, branch d = 0 (kappa in 3..8; x = 0, e = t forced, dim T = t, F_T a basis, |F_8| = 8): (i) the Swap(+carrier) inequality for dim T in {2,3}; (ii) weight-8 members with h of D7/E6 type (|supp T| >= 5, up to 37 lines); (iii) the F1 step (p_h + tau vanishing on O_{l_v} implies h proportional to c_v) for |supp tau| in 18..37 (t=2) / 18..22 (t=3); F1 is checked only to 17. Branch d >= 1: the finite T-level survivor lists, 35 multisets at t = 2 and 280 at t = 3 (CHECKED twice: CONJG2 and AUD-3 land_mine.py; the DP+LP filters are shared imports), each needs a kill. | a proof of (i)-(iii), and a kill of each of the 35 + 280 survivors (the [7^{d+1},w] chain with e = 2 needs TWOSIDE's F7+P) | `checks/CONJG2/NOTES.md` sec. 2-4 |
| C2 | K1 | R-dep for s >= 2 (Hall-violating configurations: >= 3 dependent classes on swap lines, a dependent T cap S_a with >= 4 lines; |S_a| <= 11, finite in principle, not run) and the s = 1 N2 pattern (the w = 1 sub-residue of every (1,t) cell is exactly #2816's open residue rho_0 > Delta) | the finite enumeration of the Hall-violating configurations, and Theorem L for rho_0 > Delta | `checks/RDEP2/NOTES.md`, `checks/RDEP3/NOTES.md` |
| C3 | K1 | Theorem S (cost >= 7m - Lambda_P - Lambda_Q + sum slack_k - n01): tight configurations with s >= 2 inside the budget def_P + def_Q + sum slack' <= 7 - s - t + n01 (sharp: met with equality at 64 by four witness cells), including the cost-0 (8,1)/(1,8)-type residue at the boundary Lambda_P + n01 <= t - 1 (n01 <= t) | exclusion of every configuration meeting the budget (finite per cell) | `checks/RDEP3/NOTES.md` "Exact residue", AUD-3 report item 3 |
| C4 | K1 | Theorem DR' residues (c1) delta_row/delta_col > 0 for s >= 2; (c2) SH pairs whose e meets F_row cup X cup O' column pivots plus the re-gauging bookkeeping; (c3) the O-move/O-residue of sec. 6 and O4-2 sec. 7 (SU failure, K_small != K^s, forced Pi cap Pi' nonempty) | proofs of c1-c3 | `checks/RDEP2/NOTES.md` "Exact residue after RDEP2" |

With K579T Theorem K5 and R579b Lemmas K5^-, K5^-2 (each double-implemented) the non-root pair graph N has >= 6 edges; DEG2 gives N a matching, hence e_N <= 4 < 6, contradiction. ## C6 partial evidence (impl A only: evidence, not proof)
`checks/DEG2/` (`triA.c`, outputs `C0_*.out`, `NOTES.md`): three sevens, relaxed third pair, E = 3F4 + F3. Mask-orbit reps 0, 2, 3, 7 and 9 give 0 coverable configurations (rep 9 is recorded in `DEG2/NOTES.md`; its output file is not shipped). Reps 4, 6, 1 and 8 have coverable configurations: rep 4 464 of 1808 distinct U (min |U| 25), rep 6 196 of 505 (min 24), rep 1 5181 of 10537 (min 23), rep 8 414 of 3026 (min 23). Rep 5 is unfinished (killed at the time cap). Closing C6 needs the 4th/5th-seven stage on the coverable triples of reps 1, 4, 6 and 8 (and rep 5 once finished), plus an independent second implementation.
